business_summary: Guangdong Decro Film New Materials Co., Ltd. is involved in the research, development, production, and sales of functional films and functional masterbatches in China. The company offers BOPP and BOPE films products. It serves rubber and plastic products industries. Guangdong Decro Film New Materials Co., Ltd. was founded in 1999 and is based in Foshan, China.
